description: This file implements an impersonation provider for authentication, including functions for permission checks, user impersonation, and audit logging within a system that uses NextAuth, Prisma, and custom permission logic.

methods.name: parseTeamId
methods.description: Parses and validates the teamId from credentials using zod schema.

methods.name: checkSelfImpersonation
methods.description: Prevents a user from impersonating themselves based on session and credentials.

methods.name: checkUserIdentifier
methods.description: Ensures that a username or returnToId is present in credentials.

methods.name: checkGlobalPermission
methods.description: Checks if the session user has global permission to impersonate, based on role and environment variable.

methods.name: checkPBACImpersonationPermission
methods.description: Checks PBAC permissions for impersonation at organization or team level.
